applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it only says the issue is underdetermined after both sides answered.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The rule governs counting an answered verse as an unanswered witness, and this judge text does not make such a count.
